[RFCS.16.3] A reader **must** determine the band of any unknown field number from the
number alone and apply the band's disposition. Blind-wise the outcomes are only two —
**reject** (inject ∪ reject-don't-skip) or **skip**; the split between the two reject
bands selects only which error code is reported ([NERR.13]), a known-reader concern.

A field number in **no** band — `0`, or any number above `2047` ([RFCS.16.2]) — is not
an atom, known or future. A reader **must** refuse the container that carries one as
malformed, and **must not** skip it.

The bands govern an `Atom`'s `body` field number. A field inside a known atom's body
that the reader does not know is skipped, as protobuf skips it; within one
`<major>.<minor>.` series ([LDET.1.10]) that can only be a field the series has
struck and reserved, which nothing may read ([STYL.2.8.7]).
